Given a developer creates a feature branch, when changes are committed and pushed, then the branch is available to the team.

Given the house completes an action, when the action is resolved, then all relevant players see the updated game state.
Given a game requires the house to act, when the house turn begins, then the system automatically selects actions according to that game's defined house rules.
Given a player attempts to bet more than the available balance or submits an invalid amount, when the bet is submitted, then the system rejects it.
Given betting is open, when a player submits a valid bet within the available balance, then the system records the bet.
Given a player enters a game that uses money, when the game view loads, then the player's current balance is available to the system and visible where appropriate.
Given an invalid or inactive game ID is entered, when the player selects Join, then the system rejects the request and displays an error.
Given a valid active game ID is entered on the joining page, when the player selects Join, then the system connects the player to the corresponding lobby.
Given a new lobby is created, when creation succeeds, then the system generates a game ID that identifies that lobby.
Given a player disconnects, when the disconnect is detected, then the remaining session continues or handles the disconnect according to the game rules.
Given multiple players are connected to the same lobby, when one player's game state changes, then the relevant update is synchronized to the other players.
Given the host attempts to start before required conditions are met, when Start Game is selected, then the system prevents the start and explains why.
Given the host is in the lobby, when the minimum requirements for the selected game are met, then the host can start the game.
Given a lobby exists, when players join or leave, then the lobby list updates for connected users.
Given game creation fails, when the failure occurs, then the system informs the host and does not create a partial lobby.
Given a new lobby is created, when creation succeeds, then the system assigns the creator as host and generates a unique game ID.
Given the host is on the home page, when the host selects Create Game and completes required setup, then the system creates a new lobby.
Given the host starts the game, when the session is ready, then all connected players transition to the selected game page.
Given the player is connected to a lobby, when the pre-game page loads, then connected players are displayed.
Given valid information is entered, when the player selects Join, then the system attempts to connect the player to the matching lobby.
Given the player selects Join Game, when the joining page loads, then fields for the game ID and required player information are displayed.
Given the player selects a home-page option, when the selection is made, then the system navigates to the appropriate page.
Given the player opens the application, when the home page loads, then options to create a game, join a game, and access help or instructions are displayed.
Given interactive controls are displayed, when the player views the page, then buttons, labels, and important game information are readable.
Given a player moves between major screens, when each screen loads, then the interface uses a consistent layout, typography, and visual style.
